Company: esumry.com Location: West Austin TX ONSITE (mostly)

What we do esumry is an AI litigation platform built for defense. We help trial lawyers and claims professionals cut pretrial busywork across depositions, medical records, pleadings, and the rest of the case file so they can spend time on strategy instead of document wrangling.

About the role We are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to develop and maintain esumry with our startup development team, on an enterprise-grade AWS stack. This role is primarily in-office (coworking space) in the west Austin TX area.

more info: https://wellfound.com/jobs/4824572-software-engineer
